description: What is failing: error (and fatal) log lines grouped by message, with ids, uuids, IPs and numbers normalized so repeats are one group. Each group: a sample line, how many times, first and last seen, environments, exception type and sample trace ids (pass one to securenow_logs_for_trace or securenow_traces_show). Far cheaper than listing raw logs. includeWarn adds warnings.

appKeys.description: Application key or comma-separated/list of application keys.

environment.description: Deployment environment scope: production, staging, preview, local, test, or all. Default for investigations is production.

name: securenow_logs_errors
title: Summarize Error Logs
